safety.no_static_forearm_stretch: No static forearm stretching before performance (CUE-02).
safety.fueling_framing_only: All nutrition guidance is fueling/performance only, never weight (D64).

project.warmup_protocol: General 8–15 min: pulse-raise 5–10 min @ 40–60% (the approach often covers this), then mobility (wrist/shoulder/hip) + finger pulsing. Then a graduated-pump pyramid matched to the objective (long routes for a long project, steep/bouldery for a short power route): onsight−3 → −2 → −1 → REST → burns. Example 7c project: ~6b → 6c → 7a → rest → attempts. Criticality: high (max neural). No full-crimp while cold; no static forearm stretching pre-effort.
project.target_burns: 3–5 good redpoint efforts. When close to the send: fewer, better.
project.rest_between_attempts_min: 20–45+ min between burns (work:rest ≈ 1:4; lean to ~60 min when close). Use rests as active rest: walk, rehydrate, rehearse beta.
stop_criteria: Movement quality drops (feet cutting, sloppy placements, missing known beta)
Skin thinning / hot spots / glassy tips
Neural fatigue: repeated failure on a move you did cleanly earlier
Pump won't clear within a normal rest
Two consecutive worse attempts → end the burn-set
skin_tips: Carry a skin kit: fine file/sandpaper, clippers, tape
Sand to prevent flappers, not to thin
Chalk is moisture management, not a constant layer; brush holds
Sweaty tips: liquid chalk / witch hazel
When skin is sensitive, climb static and slow
Best protection: know when to call it — a last burn can cost 3 recovery days
project.time_of_day_advice: Summer: save burns for the cool early AM / evening / shade. Winter: climb the warmest part of the day to keep fingers functional.
project.hours_plan: 3–5 h (≈2–4 quality burns; long rests dominate the clock).
project.downgrade_rule: On a red flag (finger/tendon niggle, skin past safe, dehydration ≥1.5% BW, cold-numb fingers) → downgrade to Volume/Scout or rest.

onsight_flash.warmup_protocol: Same general phase + graduated-pump pyramid (criticality high — one chance). Add heavy ground route-reading and a pacing/commit mindset. Onsight ≈ redpoint−1 number grade for expectation-setting.
onsight_flash.target_burns: 1 max attempt per route (by definition). Several different routes per day are fine.
onsight_flash.rest_between_attempts_min: Between near-max routes treat like redpoint recovery (20–45 min). Pace to freshness.
skin_tips: Manage skin across multiple routes — don't burn it early
onsight_flash.hours_plan: 3–6 h (project-like if near max, volume-like if sub-max).

volume.warmup_protocol: Ramp grades into the day (e.g. 6a → 6b → 6c → into onsight-level pitches). Lower criticality than project/onsight — the early pitches double as warm-up.
volume.target_burns: 6–10+ sub-max pitches, bounded by pump/skin (not neural quality).
volume.rest_between_attempts_min: Active rest between pitches (walk, light shake, G-Tox). Keep efforts below the pump/anaerobic threshold; pace to skin and pump.
stop_criteria: Pump won't clear within a normal rest
skin_tips: Same kit; sand to prevent flappers
volume.time_of_day_advice: Conditions matter less (sub-max), but cool/dry still helps friction.
volume.downgrade_rule: Persistent next-day fatigue / illness → easy or rest.

scout_easy.warmup_protocol: Light, sub-max, skin-sparing. Doubles as active recovery.
scout_easy.target_burns: No max efforts — beta gathering, exploration, technique, recovery.
stop_criteria: Stop if it stops being easy/recovery

slab.warmup_protocol_add: Prime feet/calves, precision, low-grip; mental focus.
slab.skin_note: EXTREME condition sensitivity (dry-fire risk when cold-dry); scrappy low-angle falls (skin/ankle).

overhang.warmup_protocol_add: Finger recruitment, pulling, body tension, commit.

roof.warmup_protocol_add: Finger recruitment, pulling, body tension, commit.

short_power.rest_between_attempts_min_override: Longer relative rest (~5:1 rest:work); recover power between burns; fewer max moves.

long_endurance.strategy_add: Pump management is the constraint: mid-route shakeouts / G-Tox, pacing.
long_endurance.warmup_note: Warm up on longer routes to prime aerobic delivery.

crimp.skin_note: Skin loaded on tips (split risk); avoid full-crimp cold.

base.nudge: Base phase — Volume / onsight-mileage / scout fit best.

build.nudge: Build phase — favor Volume / capacity; few max redpoint days.

peak.nudge: Peak phase — Project / send days fit.

performance.nudge: Performance phase — a Project day is the real-rock realization session.

deload.nudge: Deload / pre-trip — scale volume; rest or easy.

prime.nudge: Prime conditions — spend your max burns now; Project/send appropriate.

ok.nudge: OK conditions — normal plan; manage skin/heat.

poor_hot_humid.nudge: Hot/humid — consider downgrading to Volume/Scout or rest; precool; seek shade/wind; protect skin (weaker when wet); save effort.

poor_cold_dry.nudge: Cold-dry — warm hands between burns; beware glassy tips; manage skin cracking.
